cc:Work.dc:title: ALPS static quality factors
cc:Work.dc:description: Independent derived static factors from immutable heavyRule=off executed-capacity.json. Original per-call allowance 8s; 10-12s targets evaluated post hoc only. Five holdout observations per algorithm. Nonoccupied envelope volume is not trapped void.
